IPX.physical_anchor: Produces titanium metal powder and sponge from mineral-sand ore via a hydrogen-based (HAMR) reduction process at its Titan Valley, Virginia facility; also holds a Tennessee critical-minerals project targeting rare-earth/titanium byproduct extraction.
IPX.value_chain_position: Pre-commercial titanium-metal producer (mine-to-metal), DPA Title III / DoD-funded strategic-metal build-out, not yet at nameplate revenue.

LAC.physical_anchor: Develops the Thacker Pass lithium clay deposit in Nevada, aiming to produce lithium carbonate.
LAC.value_chain_position: Pre-revenue lithium-clay developer; lithium is not a covered chain in this taxonomy version (no lithium chain exists — uranium, copper, precious metals, rare-earth/strategic, diversified-miners only), so this is an industry-filter false positive despite a real physical anchor.

LAR.physical_anchor: Holds the producing Caucharí-Olaroz lithium brine operation (Argentina JV) plus exploration-stage lithium assets, producing lithium carbonate via evaporation/processing.
LAR.value_chain_position: Lithium-brine producer/JV holder; equity-accounted JV revenue does not flow to the parent P&L (ttm_revenue=0 here). Lithium is not a covered chain in this taxonomy version — industry-filter false positive.

LEU.physical_anchor: Enriches uranium (SWU) into low-enriched uranium (LEU) and HALEU fuel via centrifuge cascades at its Piketon, Ohio plant, and fabricates related nuclear fuel components under DOE/commercial contracts.
LEU.value_chain_position: Conversion & enrichment layer — sells enriched uranium product (SWU/LEU/HALEU) and technical fuel services directly into the reactor fuel-cycle chain.

LWLG.physical_anchor: Manufactures organic electro-optic polymer thin-film materials used in photonic integrated circuits for optical datacom/telecom transceivers — a photonics materials company, not a metal or mineral.
LWLG.value_chain_position: Specialty photonic-materials supplier to optical component makers; caught by the 'Chemicals - Specialty' industry string used to sweep rare-earth processors — no mining-chain relevance.

LYB.physical_anchor: Manufactures polyethylene, polypropylene, and other petrochemicals from oil/gas feedstocks at global refining and cracking complexes — a petrochemicals producer, not a metal or mineral extractor.
LYB.value_chain_position: Global commodity-chemicals/plastics producer; caught by the 'Chemicals - Specialty' industry string used to sweep rare-earth separators/processors — no mining-chain relevance.

MP.physical_anchor: Mines and separates rare-earth ore (bastnaesite) into NdPr oxide concentrate at Mountain Pass, California, and is scaling downstream into sintered NdFeB magnet manufacturing (incl. DoD-backed capacity).
MP.value_chain_position: Mining and separation layer plus emerging magnet-alloy production — sells rare-earth concentrate/oxide and, increasingly, finished NdFeB magnets.

MTX.physical_anchor: Mines limestone and bentonite clay and processes them into engineered mineral products (precipitated calcium carbonate, specialty additives) for paper, environmental, and construction customers.
MTX.value_chain_position: Industrial-minerals processor (limestone/bentonite to specialty additives), not a rare-earth or strategic-metal name; caught by the 'Chemicals - Specialty' industry string.

MUX.physical_anchor: Operates underground/open-pit gold-silver mines (Fox Complex Canada, Gold Bar Nevada, El Gallo Mexico) producing doré bars.
MUX.value_chain_position: Mid-tier/emerging gold-silver producer selling doré; separately holds a majority stake in the pre-production Los Azules copper project (McEwen Copper), which is not yet revenue-generating and is excluded from the current commodity mix.

NAK.physical_anchor: Holds and is permitting the Pebble copper-gold-molybdenum porphyry deposit in Alaska; no mine built, permit denied by the Army Corps with ongoing litigation/appeals.
NAK.value_chain_position: Pre-permit copper-gold-moly developer — a genuine copper deposit, but the project sits well outside the taxonomy's 'permitted/FID-stage' developer bar given the permit denial and litigation overhang.

NB.physical_anchor: Developing the Elk Creek niobium-scandium-titanium-rare earth deposit in Nebraska, pre-production, working toward a construction financing decision.
NB.value_chain_position: Strategic-metals developer (niobium primary, scandium/titanium/rare-earth byproducts) — niobium is a textbook export-chokepoint strategic metal (CBMM/Brazil dominance).

NEXA.physical_anchor: Mines and smelts zinc, copper, and lead concentrates (with silver byproduct) at integrated operations and refineries in Peru and Brazil.
NEXA.value_chain_position: Base-metal mid-tier producer with own smelting/refining — zinc-dominant multi-metal book (zinc/copper/lead/silver), fits the diversified-miners 'base-metal mid-tiers' layer better than the single-commodity copper chain.

NG.physical_anchor: Co-develops (50% JV with Barrick) the Donlin Gold deposit in Alaska, a large permitted-but-unbuilt gold resource, pre-production.
NG.value_chain_position: Permitted/construction-stage gold developer — Donlin is fully permitted but awaiting a construction go-ahead and financing.

NUCL.physical_anchor: Explores and aims to develop uranium mineral deposits toward future ISR/conventional production; no producing asset yet.
NUCL.value_chain_position: Early-stage uranium exploration/development layer (mining & ISR production), pre-revenue, small-cap.

NXE.physical_anchor: Developing the Rook I high-grade uranium deposit in the Athabasca Basin, Saskatchewan — one of the largest undeveloped uranium resources globally, pre-production/permitted construction stage.
NXE.value_chain_position: Permitted/construction-stage uranium developer (mining & ISR/conventional production layer) — pure-play uranium, no byproducts.

OGC.physical_anchor: Operates open-pit/underground gold mines (Haile, South Carolina; Waihi, New Zealand; Didipio, Philippines — gold-copper porphyry) producing doré and copper-gold concentrate.
OGC.value_chain_position: Established multi-mine gold producer with a copper-byproduct asset (Didipio); balance-sheet fields here are null due to a data-feed gap on this TSX/OTC-adjacent listing, not evidence against the chain fit.

OGG.physical_anchor: Ramping gold production from a construction-stage mine complex (large ongoing growth capex against small but fast-growing revenue), explicitly flagged royalty_hint=false distinguishing it from the Osisko royalty vehicle.
OGG.value_chain_position: Construction/early-production-stage gold developer (permitted/construction-stage layer); the revenue-ramp-against-heavy-capex pattern is the classic transitional producer profile, not an established miner.

PPTA.physical_anchor: Developing the Stibnite Gold-Antimony deposit in Idaho — a permitted, DoD/EXIM-backed construction-stage project producing both gold and strategic antimony.
PPTA.value_chain_position: Dual-commodity permitted/construction-stage developer — gold (precious metals) and antimony (a named export-chokepoint strategic metal with US government price-floor/stockpile backing).

PRM.physical_anchor: Manufactures ammonium-phosphate wildfire retardant (Phos-Chek) and firefighting foam — a specialty-chemicals producer with no mining/mineral-extraction linkage.
PRM.value_chain_position: Fire-suppression chemicals manufacturer; caught by the 'Chemicals - Specialty' industry string used to sweep rare-earth processors — no mining-chain relevance.

RYAM.physical_anchor: Manufactures high-purity cellulose specialty pulp (for acetate, filters, etc.) and paperboard from harvested wood fiber — a forestry/cellulose chemicals producer, not a metal or mineral extractor.
RYAM.value_chain_position: High-purity cellulose specialty-products producer; caught by the 'Chemicals - Specialty' industry string used to sweep rare-earth processors — no mining-chain relevance.
